messages.subject: Factor Score Calculations

Hi Phil and Mirt Community, 

I am running a multipleGroup model and while it does run through all the iterations, the model never converges (see code below), so when I attempt to calculate the factor scores for each person in my data set using fscores, almost half of the results are listed as NA. I don't get any error warnings, so I am curious why there are so many NAs.  Is the lack of convergence why the factor scores for all the respondents cannot be calculated? I tried EAP, MAP, and ML and all have the same issue.

test <- read.csv(QuestionDataSet6.13.18.csv)
itemT <- rep('2PL',10)

Grouped_MIRT_Model_All3<- multipleGroup(test[,c(3:12)], 
                                    model = 2,
                                    group = test$V2.x,
                                    rotate = "none",
                                    invariance = c("slopes","intercepts"), 
                                    itemtype=itemT,
                                    method = "MCEM",
                                    survey.weights = test$V258.x,
                                    large=TRUE)

Grouped_MIRT_Model_All4<- multipleGroup(test[,c(3:12)], 
                                    model = 2,
                                    group = as.character(test$V2.x),
                                    rotate = "none",
                                    invariance = c("slopes","intercepts"), 
                                    itemtype=itemT,
                                    method = "MCEM",
                                    survey.weights = test$V258.x,
                                    large=Grouped_MIRT_Model_All3,
                                    technical=list(removeEmptyRows=TRUE))

scores <- fscores(Grouped_MIRT_Model_All4, QMC=TRUE)

Any help is greatly appreciated!
